contract.consumer: VDP_WriteTileWord at 0x001B21A8 ORs SCENE_RESOURCE_TILE_BASE into the tile word before publishing it to VDP_DATA.
contract.transition_setup: Scene_EnterTransitionMode at 0x001B2ACE writes 0x4000 before transition tile output.

conclusion: The 16-bit word selects the active VRAM tile base for scene-resource tile emission.
